objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that passes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning and archiving lifecycle stages.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid (Level 1–4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation used in the document name (e.g. RL for guideline).

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive 4-digit number per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: User-defined title of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid, calculated from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Time span for validity checks, default 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Retention period after invalidation, default 10 years.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original Office format of the document content (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Areas of validity or relevant companies for the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to master data, IT applications, other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational areas to which the document applies.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of in which clients the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document attached to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary document attachment not subject to the release cycle, published directly via property switches without formal approval.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by an author to suggest changes to an existing released document, managed independently of the document version history.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, planned, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend or revise validity.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a released document and archive it, triggering a workflow for formal suspension.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated (archived) document, created by the Business Admin group.

objs.name: author
objs.description: A user assigned the author role who creates and maintains documents and signs the first workflow step.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: A user with additional write permissions on a document who can initiate the release workflow but does not sign as creator.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A user who checks document content for technical and formal correctness during the review step of the release workflow.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A user responsible for final approval of a document, deciding whether it is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A user who translates released document content into another language; cannot create new objects independently.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A user who can only view approved documents and confirm acknowledgement when requested.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A defined group of users used to assign read or change authorizations and distribution lists for documents.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Type of group such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, or Business Admin.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A maintained list of user groups and persons who are automatically informed about document releases, either by email or for acknowledgement.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process instance that manages approval steps including creator sign-off, review, and release with electronic signatures.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (release, validity extension, override, reactivation, translation release, acknowledgement).

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by workflow participants to confirm completion of their workflow step.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, used when creating new document objects, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

objs.name: report
objs.description: An evaluation report providing filtered document information based on selection parameters and criteria.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Type of report (e.g. Status report, Search for documents, Acknowledgement status).

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen during creation.

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The template selected for the new document, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or modified via the properties editing dialog.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: The property category being edited (e.g. Master data, Control release).

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval workflow (Creator–Review–Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author completes the creator step of the release workflow with an electronic signature.

evts.name: sign_review_step
evts.description: A reviewer completes the review step by confirming technical or formal check with an electronic signature.

evts.name: sign_release_step
evts.description: A releaser completes the release step with an electronic signature, finalizing document approval.

evts.name: reject_review
evts.description: A reviewer rejects the document during the review step, canceling the workflow for all subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided for rejecting the document during review.

evts.name: reject_release
evts.description: A releaser rejects the document during the release step, canceling the workflow for all subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided for rejecting the document during release.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created due to content changes, attribute changes, attachment changes, or change proposal scheduling.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: Reason for new version creation (content change, attribute change, attachment change, change proposal).

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving; actual archiving occurs upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is attached to a document without affecting the main document version or release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is removed from a document without creating a new version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is planned for implementation, triggering creation of a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of a change proposal, notifying the proposal creator; the completed proposal is removed from the document display.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before a document's valid-until date.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser (or author/reviewer/releaser in Process 2) confirms validity extension, updating the valid-until date by the default period.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document and initiate the override workflow.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The override workflow is completed; the document receives the Out of Force status, rights are revoked except for the archive group, and the archive duration begins.

evts.name: physical_delete
evts.description: After the archive period expires, documents are physically deleted from the system.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A member of the Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: The reactivation workflow is confirmed, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata, authorizations, distribution lists, and attachments.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual persons for a document.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Type of authorization assigned (read, write).

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement of a released document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A reader confirms acknowledgement of a document through a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: start_translation
evts.description: Translation of released document content into another language is initiated.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is being translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated language version passes through the approval workflow and is released, making it visible to readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends an email notification to inform users about workflow tasks, status changes, or distribution events.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Type of notification (workflow task, release info, validity extension info, override info, acknowledgement request).
